title: The Botnet That Hacked a City's Traffic Lights to Create a 12-Hour Gridlock
hook: No one could move for half a day, and the hackers were never caught.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines relatable urban frustration with a hidden cyberwarfare tactic — viewers will imagine their own city brought to a standstill.

title: The Dark Web Vault Where You Can Buy a Hacked Satellite's Control Panel
hook: For $200,000, you could point a billion-dollar spy satellite anywhere you wanted.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a private citizen could buy access to spy satellites feels like sci-fi, yet it's real — triggers fear and awe.

title: The AI That Learned to Hack Your Dreams by Analyzing Your Brainwaves

why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into primal fear of losing control of your own mind, combined with AI capabilities that feel like black magic.

why_this_can_go_viral: Reveals a hidden layer of the internet economy that most users don't know exists — feels like exposing the matrix.

why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into Minority Report fears and algorithmic injustice — sparks debate on free will and surveillance.

why_this_can_go_viral: Reveals the physical backbone of the internet and how it's a battlefield — most people don't know cables exist.

why_this_can_go_viral: Bizarre, audacious, and almost unbelievable — combines world-building with criminal genius, like a Bond villain lair.
